title: Hinomori Shiho — Imagining That Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're coming along pretty nicely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, it was so easy to play just now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because Honami's doing such a great job of leading us. I didn't have to adjust on the fly. It was like I could just play because I could hear everything so clearly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still think I can do better if I work on the little things a bit more on my own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, that'd be great.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That being said...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Honami did say she has a blister.
I think she's been trying to go easy a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, one of the staff is here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Do they need something?
We should still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
I apologize for interrupting your practice.
But the person who booked the studio after you just called in to cancel...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: So, would you like to extend your time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, if we could...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, wait.
You just said that you'd work on all the little stuff on your own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uh, yes. I did say that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's stick to the amount of time we had planned here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She's right, Hona!
What do we do if your blister pops?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree with Shiho, especially since we have this place booked tomorrow anyway.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, alright...
Thank you all for your concern.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
We'll be leaving once our time is up.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, let's pick up where we left off.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
We really practiced a lot again today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm getting a bit hungry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That reminds me... Shizuku said that a new bakery opened up near Nonogi Park.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nice out, so wanna go check it out and eat in the park?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, we can sort of have a picnic!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, but can I stop by the pharmacy first?
I'd like to buy some gauze and such for my hand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go with you.
I can see what kinds of drinks they have for us to buy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
In that case, let's split up.
Honami, Ichika, you two go to the pharmacy. Saki and I will go buy us some bread.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything either of you want?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Do you really have to ask...?
A yakisoba bun and an apple pie, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was asking just in case.
What if they were feeling something different?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Uhh...
A yakisoba bun would be nice if they have any...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: An apple pie for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, the usual it is!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's meet back up in the park once we have our things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, we'll let you know if anything happens.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we should...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bakery♪ Bakery♪
We want some yummy bread♪
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, wait!
I haven't actually told you where it is yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's by the park, right?
Hehe. Delicious bread awaits us!
se_run_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki, stop!
Going this way is faster!
